questions.prompt_md: Choose the correct option: *I ___ my keys yesterday.*
questions.explanation_md: *Yesterday* es un momento terminado: past simple.

questions.prompt_md: Choose the correct option: *If I ___ more money, I would buy a car.*
Complete with the passive (past simple): *The order ___ ___ yesterday.* (*deliver*). Write the two words.
Choose the correct relative pronoun: *The employee ___ car broke down arrived late.*
*"I will finish the report tomorrow," Ana said.* Which is the correct reported speech?

choices.text: Ana said she will finish the report tomorrow.
Ana said she would finish the report the next day.
Ana told she would finish the report.
Ana said I would finish the report the next day.

questions.explanation_md: *will* → *would*; *tomorrow* → *the next day*; *I* → *she*. (c) es incorrecta: *tell* necesita persona (*told me*).
